title: AhaSend webhook evidence manifest

serverCommit.description: Server revision the evidence corresponds to: the revision that sent the bytes for `captured`, or the revision whose payload structs were serialised for `derived`.

headerRecordFormat.description: Exact UTF-8 record hashed by headersSha256; it is an integrity record, not a replacement for persisted signed header values.

rawBodySha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact fixture bytes. The file stores the payload verbatim, with no trailing newline, so this digest and the signature match what the server emits.

signature.description: Fixed HMAC-SHA256 over webhookId + '.' + webhookTimestamp + '.' + the exact raw body bytes.

headersSha256.description: SHA-256 of headerRecordFormat populated with the three exact persisted header values.

idSha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string type + ':' + id.

keySha256.description: SHA-256 of the literal UTF-8 resource key, excluding the key file's terminating LF.

bindingSha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string type + ':' + id + ':' + keySha256.

kind.description: Body bytes were observed on the wire from a running server.

Body bytes were produced by serialising the server's payload structs, not observed on the wire. Agrees with the producer by construction, so it guards against future drift rather than proving present wire-correctness.

generator.description: Path, in the server repository, of the serialisation entry point.

producerStructs.description: Server source files whose struct definitions were serialised.

producerTreeClean.description: False when the serialised structs included uncommitted working-tree changes, so serverCommit alone does not identify them.

description: Signed webhook fixture evidence. Each capture records how its body bytes were obtained: `captured` for bytes observed on the wire from a running server, `derived` for bytes produced by serialising the server's own payload structs. Derived evidence proves the SDK stays in step with the producer's source; it is not evidence of what a live server sent.
